target_name: Profit State And News Safely Funded
rationale: This is an average of two already-tested signals against the identical maturity leg — level×NEG(dlc/lt) (alpha 4.0%, t=3.55) and delta×NEG(dlc/lt) (alpha 3.3%, t=3.03) — so the expected result is mechanically bracketed by its two parents, and the outer RANK around SUMRANK is a redundant monotone wrapper; it is a cosmetic recombination rather than a new economic hypothesis.

An untested pairing of two archive legs whose diagnostic purpose (does the profit-change leg need maturity safety specifically or generic slack?) is legitimate and the expression matches the hypothesis, but it remains leg-swapping within a saturated family and both parents' alphas set a low ceiling on incremental information.

The stated coverage defence is incorrect — SUMRANK needs both inputs, so the sparse oancf leg (0.08 in the gen-0 test) will bind the whole signal's coverage rather than being cushioned by the dense maturity leg, and the likely outcome is the archive's best-performing leg diluted and its sample halved, which is uninterpretable as evidence about cash-based safety.

The construction is internally consistent and the argument that a ratio-change captures both numerator and denominator improvement is fair, but the two legs share oibdp so a large part of the product is a squared profitability term, and the deleveraging channel it adds resembles "Profits Not Propped By New Debt," which produced negative alpha.

R&D intensity is a genuinely new channel for this archive and the funding-safety interaction is economically coherent, but xrd/sale is a long-published anomaly proxy, COALESCE-to-zero creates a large tied mass at the bottom of the rank, and R&D intensity is negatively correlated with contemporaneous oibdp/at so the SUMRANK may partly cancel the profitability leg it is meant to reinforce.

Unlike the rest of the batch this fuses the liquidity and debt legs into a single scale-free net-financial-position quantity rather than averaging ranks, giving it a distinct functional form and a monotone economic interpretation, though it is close to the standard net-debt construct and its incremental value over the existing NWC/lt leg (alpha 4.1%) is uncertain.
